title: CALVARY'S STREAM IS FLOWING
author: Eliza E.Hewitt
stanzas: From that dear cross where Jesus died, Calvary's stream is flowing; From bleeding hands and feet aside, Calvary's stream is flowing
Come, wash the stain of sin away, Calvary's stream is flowing; Come, while tis called salvation's day, Calvary's stream is flowing
For every contrite, wounded soul, Calvary's stream is flowing; Step in just now Calvary's stream is flowing
For every weary, aching heart, Calvary's stream is flowing; A tender healing to impart, Calvary's streams is flowing.
With life and peace upon its tide, Calvary's stream is flowing; Sweet blessings down the ages glide, Calvary's stream is flowing
chorus: Calvary's stream is flowing, Calvary's stream id flowing; Flowing so free for you and for me Calvary's stream is flowing'
